sentences.text: No; for floating-rate business loans to Micro and Small Enterprises sanctioned on or after 1 January 2026, a Tier 3 UCB shall not levy any pre-payment charges on loans with sanctioned amount or limit up to ₹50 lakh, and this case is a ₹40 lakh loan sanctioned in March 2026.
The bank’s loan document states a pre-payment charge of 2% or 3% of the principal outstanding on foreclosure or pre-payment, but that conflicts with the applicable UCB directions for this case.
